caption: A dim nighttime scene is dominated by a ribbed metal fence running diagonally across the lower frame. Mounted at its top edge, a single intense white-blue light burns steadily, throwing a starburst lens flare and bright vertical streaks down the corrugated surface. Higher and slightly left, a small yellow-orange light sits on a thin post against the dark background, fixed relative to the bright source. As the camera moves, the fence, bright light and yellow light drift together across the image, first sliding right and then back left. The view also tilts downward, so the bright light sinks lower and the diagonal fence line flattens. Both lights stay continuously on at constant brightness, with no flicker, onset, or offset in this excerpt.
